hook.text: After the 2010 oil spill BP spent $500 million on ads—not cleanup, just reputation repair.

buildup.text: Corporate honor works like family honor: one scandal stains every employee and every product.

discovery.text: Reputation management is now a $5 billion industry. Companies hire firms to bury bad search results.

twist.text: Volkswagen's emissions scandal hurt German engineering's brand globally—one company shaming an entire nation.

climax.text: In the attention economy, corporate honor is the most valuable and fragile asset on the balance sheet.

punchline.text: Brands live and die by the same honor rules as clans.

quiz.question: How much did BP spend on reputation ads after the 2010 spill?
